bullets: Monitored daily production operations across a 20-ton dyeing floor, tracking workflow progress to ensure timely completion.

Prepared detailed production reports and communicated key efficiency trends to management to support data-driven decisions.
Observed and studied knitting, dyeing, sewing, and cutting processes and monitored end-to-end workflow.
Led the university literary society and coordinated activities across literature, culture, and creative expression.
Planned and led Lit Fest 2.0, Scene-Sinarir Ekdin, Shobdobindu Literary Competition, Him Utsab, a Film Festival, and the fourth stage performance of the theatre production *Onahuto*.
Helped organize the National Textile Olympiad, an event with 500+ participants.
Coordinated club members and event activities to support smooth execution.
Co-founded a student-led club promoting information technology, and organized technology workshops to help students build technical skills.

objective: A BUTEX graduate interested in the intersection of technology, business and creativity. My professional interests are evolving towards marketing, supply chain management, operations and business strategy. I enjoy understanding how industries function, how businesses create value and how better decisions can improve processes and outcomes. Outside the professional sphere, I'm drawn to literature, visual arts, design and cultural initiatives. I believe curiosity should never be confined to one discipline, and neither should a career.
